flag.name: Flag of Georgia
flag.description: Three horizontal stripes alternating red, white, red; in the canton, 13 white stars encircling the state's coat of arms on a blue field.
flag.symbolism: The design is based on the First National Flag of the Confederacy, nicknamed the "Stars and Bars." The thirteen stars represent the original thirteen colonies.

coat of amrs.name: Coat of Arms of the State of Georgia
coat of amrs.description: An arch with three columns, with the words "Wisdom, Justice, Moderation" inscribed on scrolls wrapped around the columns. A Georgia Militiaman stands between the second and third columns holding a drawn sword in his right hand.
coat of amrs.symbolism: The arch symbolizes the Constitution of Georgia, and the three columns represent the three branches of government: legislative, executive, and judicial. The militiaman represents the citizen-soldier's defense of the state Constitution.

seal.name: Great Seal of the State of Georgia
seal.description: On the obverse is centered the coat of arms of the state, surrounded by a border with the words, "State of Georgia, 1776." On the reverse is an image of Georgia's coast, with a ship bearing American flag arriving to take aboard tobacco and cotton, symbolizing export trade. A second, smaller boat represents internal traffic. On the left is a man plowing and a flock of sheep, representing agriculture. The motto "Agriculture and COmmerce, 1776" is inscribed around the outside of the image.

symbols.creed:
Accepting, as I do, the principles upon which Georgia was founded, not for self but others; -- its Democratic form of Government, based on 'Wisdom, Justice and Moderation'; --its natural resources; -- its Educational, Social and Religious advantages, making it a most desirable place to live -- I will strive to be a pure upright Citizen, rejecting the evils -- loving and emulating the good.
I further believe it is my duty to defend it against all enemies, to honor and obey its laws, to apply the Golden Rule in all my dealings with my fellow Citizens.
I feel a sense of pride in the history and heroic deeds accomplished by my forebears, and shall endeavor to so live that my State will be proud of me for doing my bit to make my State a better Commonwealth for future generations.
